then.message: Revoked: the node's link is closed

label.text: This build has no edge link. The Maximal and Enterprise packages have it.
The edge link starts with the HTTPS listener, and it is not running in this process.

This node is not an edge node, so no local nodes pair with it. An edge node runs with node_role set to edge (conf/MoquiEdgeConf.xml), and a full server that also takes a local node's link with node_role set to all-in-one (conf/MoquiAllInOneConf.xml). To pair this node with an edge node, use Edge Node.

box-header.title: This edge node takes no links

label.text: Local nodes paired with this edge node. A local node pairs in its own System, Edge Node, with a pairing code made here.

default-field.title: This edge node's link key fingerprint
default-field.tooltip: The SHA-256 of this edge node's link key. A local node shows it in its Pair step before it pairs: check that the two match

label.text: Enter it on the local node now, with this node's address. It pairs one node, once, until ${newCodeExpire}. It is shown only this once; make another if you lose it.

default-field.title: Key
default-field.tooltip: The start of the SHA-256 of the node's key, pinned at pairing

default-field.title: Set up
default-field.tooltip: What the node's own setup, from its Edge Node wizard, set besides its host names

default-field.title: Queue
default-field.tooltip: Items waiting for the node, sent in order when its link is up; failed ones are kept

link.confirmation: Revoke ${pairedNodeId}? Its link closes, and it can link again only by pairing with a new code.

label.text: No local node is paired yet. Make a pairing code, then pair on the local node.
Records each local node copies here, read-only, to answer from while it is away.

default-field.title: Epoch
default-field.tooltip: The local node's full send these records follow

label.text: No local node has replicated a set here yet.

Records a local node replicated that claim an item this server holds itself: a mail address, a chat bridge or a phone number. The server's own item wins, and the record is not applied until the server no longer holds the item; remove it on one side.
No conflicts: no local node's record claims an item of this server's own.

default-field.title: Host name
default-field.tooltip: A public name whose DNS points at this edge node, such as erp.example.com. A name goes to one local node

default-field.title: Mode
default-field.tooltip: Passthrough: the local node ends TLS with its own certificate, and this edge node sees no content; while its link is down the connection is refused. Terminate: this edge node ends TLS with its own certificate and forwards each request; while the link is down it shows an offline page

label.text: The public names this edge node answers for its local nodes. A passthrough name's TLS goes to the local node unopened; a terminate name's requests are forwarded.

link.confirmation: Remove ${hostName}? This edge node stops answering for it.

label.text: No host names yet. Add one for a paired local node, and point its DNS at this edge node.
